title: Rush Service Terms — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
**Availability.** Marlowe & Finch Alterations offers rush service only in a service class in which rush service can be bought, and only when the shop has capacity on the day.

**Upgrade of an open ticket.** A ticket can be upgraded to rush while the work has not finished: the ticket is in dropped off or in progress status, as the ticket record shows. The upgrade moves the promised date to the date of the upgrade plus the class's rush turnaround in business days, and books the rush fee under the price-list conditions.

**Finch Circle members.**
> A Finch Circle member whose tier held on the ticket's drop-off date carries the waived rush alteration fee benefit has the rush fee waived as a Finch Circle rush fee waiver when the class's waived-rush-fee figure applies.

For a Finch Circle rush fee waiver that customer care books, this clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current Finch Circle rush fee waiver terms, under which a member whose tier carries that benefit still keeps the whole waiver where the class's figure applies. The waiver of a rush fee whose promised date the shop misses remains under these rush service terms.

**Refund and missed dates.** A rush fee is not refunded when the garment is ready on the rush promised date, and is waived in full when the shop misses that date.

## Ticket status and upgrade

| Status shown on the ticket | Upgrade to rush |
|---|---|
| dropped off | possible |
| in progress | possible |
| ready, picked up, cancelled or disposed | not possible |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A ticket in progress in a class with a 3-business-day rush turnaround is upgraded on a given day: the new promised date is 3 business days after that day.
- The rush promised date arrives and the garment is ready: the rush fee stands and is not refunded. The date arrives and the garment is not ready: the rush fee is waived in full.

superseded_clauses: A Finch Circle member whose tier held on the ticket's dropoff_date has alteration_rush_fee_waived true has the rush fee waived (waiver_reason loyalty_rush_waiver) when the class's loyalty_rush_waiver_applies is true.
